qualifications: The independent transfer replay should directly reconstruct every saved six-site adjacency and check every actual row receipt before any model overlay uses the proposed family.
Not proved redundant by these explicit sufficient criteria is not a claim of independence or minimality.
This source review performs no producer import, native model decode/build, census execution, control rerun or optimizer query.
review: The producer binds the accepted complete 68934-variable/168050-row model, its independent cold and reaped owner. Full protobuf bytes are checked without a native model or optimizer import.

Every one of the 4410 forbidden selector-pair implications is reconstructed from actual current Gram or motif rows and compared with the complete literal plan list. All 1884 edge zeros and 3096 core-pair clique rows are checked in the literal native variable namespace.
Each pruned one-edge case has either an actual zero-edge row or a forbidden endpoint/third selector-pair row plus the correct endpoint activation. The direct Boolean inequality is x_third+y_edge<=1.

Each pruned path has an explicit zero-edge/activation, mixed-quota-one, endpoint-selector-pair/activation, or containing core-pair-clique receipt. The selector-pair proof needs binary center values, which are checked. No invalid homogeneous fractional implication is asserted.

All 9360 one-edge cases and 107418 unique paths are retained in complete disposition ledgers; all 107520 path witness origins and all 61488 old quotient transports are accounted for. The latter cover exactly the 61476 previously retained literal paths.

The proposed literal rows are sorted, distinct and retain old witness/path IDs. Exact counts are 1224 one-edge and 57996 path rows, with 176436 total nonzeros, leading to 227270 total rows if appended. No model is changed by this inventory.

Old six-site adjacency enumerations are reused through their full accepted records and cold receipts. The source checks relevant forced-nonedge intersections and path site bindings; it does not claim a new six-site census.

The frozen supervisor assigns CHILD_EXITED only to returncode zero, kills/reaps its owned process group, and preserves errors/timeouts. The inventory worker has one successful terminal status. The 30-second exact check phase and 45-second owner are explicit.
